<section class="mod_article grid-center block" id="article-1402">
<div class="grid">
<h1 class="ce_headline col-12">
Vacation Rentals at the Wulfener Hals Camping and Vacation Park</h1>
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12">Vacation on Fehmarn&mdash;right by the pool and close to the beach</h2>
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-10 block">
<p>Swimmers of all ages love the vacation apartments for 4 people located right by the pool in our park. But the view of Lake Burger and the Baltic Sea, as well as the balcony or terrace, are also sure to impress. Choose the one that&rsquo;s right for you: 50 m&sup2;, 60 m&sup2;, or 90 m&sup2;&mdash;the vacation apartments are just about 50 meters from the beach. This is great news for families, sports enthusiasts, and couples planning the perfect vacation on the Baltic Sea. Plus, you&rsquo;ll have access to the wide range of recreational, dining, and entertainment options at the Wulfener Hals camping and vacation park.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<div class="col-12_lg-8 bg-grass grid">
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12_lg-8">60 m&sup2; Apartment F997 by the Pool</h2>
<div class="ce_hyperlink button button-primary col-12_md-4 block">
<a href="https://v3.onlinebooking.dk/V3WULFEN/?cbpid=520" class="hyperlink_txt" title="Ferienwohnung buchen">Book a Vacation Rental</a>
</div>
<div class="ce_text col-12 block">
<p><strong>Ground Floor for 4 people</strong><br><strong>Partially covered patio + fenced-in lawn area</strong></p>
<p><strong>Features:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Kitchen and Dining Area</li>
<li>Number of living rooms/bedrooms: three</li>
<li>Bedroom / Combined Living Room and Bedroom</li>
<li>Bathroom with shower</li>
<li>Patio / Garden with patio furniture + beach chair</li>
<li>Stove, Oven, Microwave</li>
<li>Dishwasher / Washing Machine</li>
<li>TV and stereo system</li>
<li>Parking space for a car at the house</li>
<li>Basic Wi-Fi connection, free of charge (see p. 70)</li>
<li>Dogs: Not allowed</li>
</ul>
</div>
